name: com.unity.vectorgraphics
description: The vector graphics package provides Sprite integration and SVGImage component into the Vector Graphics module in Unity 6.3 and later. The package is only required if you need Sprite Editor support, and UGUI SVGImage.

_upm.changelog:
Vector Graphics package version 3.0.0-preview.1 is only compatible with Unity 6.3 and later.

Unity 6.3 includes the Vector Graphics APIs and UI Toolkit Vector Image importer built-in. The Vector Graphics package 3.0.0-preview.1
adds Sprite and UGUI (SVGImage) support.
